train.usage: Model fitting, train-only imputation parameter estimation

validation.usage: Hyperparameter selection, feature ablation comparison, early stopping

test.usage: PERMANENTLY_QUARANTINED (Single-pass evaluation after all models and configs are frozen)

effective_sample_size_accounting.scientific_statement: Because 6-hourly fixes within the same cyclone system exhibit extreme temporal autocorrelation (r > 0.85), individual rows must NEVER be treated as independent statistical degrees of freedom. Model selection and uncertainty estimates must be evaluated at the storm cluster level.

primary_metric.name: Storm-Aggregated Mean Absolute Error (Storm-MAE)
primary_metric.formula: MAE_storm = (1 / |S|) * sum_{s in S} [ (1 / N_s) * sum_{i=1}^{N_s} |y_{s,i} - y_hat_{s,i}| ]
primary_metric.rationale: Prevents long-lived stalled storms from dominating validation decisions over short-lived rapid systems.

uncertainty_estimation_protocol.resampling_unit: system_id (entire storm sequence sampled with replacement)

preprocessing_and_missing_data_protocol.details: LightGBM and XGBoost support native NaN routing during tree splitting. For architectures requiring imputation, median imputers must be fitted strictly on TRAIN partition and transformed onto VALIDATION without refitting.
preprocessing_and_missing_data_protocol.scaling_policy: NO_SCALING (Decision tree algorithms are monotonic and invariant to monotonic feature scaling; scaling is omitted by design)

model_selection_hierarchy: 4. Inter-Storm Stability (lowest standard deviation of storm-specific MAEs)
5. Parsimony (if storm-MAE difference is <= 0.2 kt, choose lower complexity / fewer features)
